svg.title: RTM4 — Block pedestrian crossing
svg.desc: Drawn to specification, not traced. Source: SARTSM Vol 1 §7.2.4(2); NRTR 2000 reg 286(2)(c)(iii), reg 315. Rectangular white blocks, minimum 2,4 m long and 600 mm wide, spaced 600 mm apart, across the full width of the roadway. Blocks run WITH the direction of travel.
